title: Genetic Cancellation Handling Fee: When It Applies and the Fee Basis
content:
The genetic cancellation handling fee is the fee posted when a patient cancels their own Laboratory Test Orders accession of the Hereditary & Reproductive Genetic Testing class before testing starts.

## When a fee applies

A genetic cancellation handling fee applies only when the accession is cancelled from *accessioned* or *testing hold*. A cancellation from *received* or *information hold* carries no handling fee.

| Status of the genetic accession at cancellation | Handling fee |
|---|---|
| Received | none (0.00) |
| Information hold | none (0.00) |
| Accessioned | the fee basis |
| Testing hold | the fee basis |

## The fee

The genetic cancellation handling fee is the **fee basis**, which is the class's cancellation handling fee after accessioning. It is posted as one charge line with the reason *cancellation handling fee*, is never below zero, and is rounded to two decimal places only at the end.

## Cancellations of other service classes

A patient's cancellation of an accession of any class other than Hereditary & Reproductive Genetic Testing and Esoteric Reference Testing remains the patient's own decision, confirmed by the patient personally. When such an order is cancelled from *accessioned* or *testing hold* and its class's cancellation handling fee after accessioning is above 0.00, one charge line with the reason *cancellation handling fee* is posted at that amount. No handling fee applies to such a cancellation before accessioning.

**Example (hypothetical class fee of 15.00).** An order of such a class cancelled from testing hold receives one handling-fee line of 15.00. The same order cancelled while still received receives none.
